EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows clear aromatic signatures: strong ring-breathing near 997 cm⁻¹ (typical for para-disubstituted benzene), aromatic C–H stretch at 3065 cm⁻¹ and ring C=C stretches at 1580/1596 cm⁻¹ (consistent with sp² carbon, cf. GFQ-003 for C–H stretches and GFQ-062/SPC-009 for the ~1580 cm⁻¹ sp² band). A very strong band at 718 cm⁻¹ is consistent with an aryl C–Cl stretch, and a band at 1095 cm⁻¹ matches a C–O stretch of an ether. The presence of both S and Cl can explain additional low-frequency modes at 541–557 cm⁻¹ (C–S/C–Cl region). Candidate 2 (COCSc1ccc(Cl)cc1) uniquely combines an aromatic ring, a para Cl substituent, an ether (C–O), and sulfur, matching the observed pattern.
